Reason: The chest X-ray (Figure 1a) demonstrates symmetric, bilateral hilar lymphadenopathy with clear lung fields and no parenchymal infiltrates. In the context of sarcoidosis staging (Scadding classification), isolated bilateral hilar lymphadenopathy without pulmonary involvement corresponds to Stage I.
